briefTitle: Study of RET Inhibitor TAS0953/HM06 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors With RET Gene Abnormalities

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Available RET-gene abnormalities determined on tissue biopsy or liquid biopsy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: RET abnormalities are a target biomarker category without a single dedicated typed kind in the allowed list.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate hematopoietic, hepatic and renal function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Broad statement without specific numeric lab cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable and/or non-measurable disease as determined by RECIST 1.1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: If patient has brain and/or leptomeningeal metastases, (s)he should be asymptomatic.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Mentions symptomatic status without a standard brain_mets category check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: asymptomatic untreated brain/leptomeningeal metastases off steroids and anticonvulsant for at least 7 days or asymptomatic brain metastases already treated with local therapy and be clinically stable on steroids and anticonvulsant for at least 7 days before study drug administration.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Contains complex medication washouts and symptom criteria alongside brain metastasis states.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC is in scope but does not list specific numbered stages for stage_in.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients who have been treated with neo-adjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy may be included if it has been completed at least 6 months prior to the first dose of the study.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Detailed prior therapy timing window and condition.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Investigational agents or anticancer therapy within 5 half-lives prior to the first dose of study drug
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Half-life-based washout window is not a simple fixed-day lab or time cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Major surgery (excluding placement of vascular access) within 4 weeks prior to the first dose of study drug or planned major surgery during the course of study treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgery washout rule is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Whole Brain Radiotherapy within 14 days or other palliative radiotherapy within 7 days prior to the first dose of study drug, or persisting side effects of such therapy, in the opinion of the Investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Radiotherapy washout rules involve investigator opinion and multiple timeframes.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Clinically significant, uncontrolled, cardiovascular disease including myocardial infarction within 3 months prior to Day 1 of Cycle 1, unstable angina pectoris, significant valvular or pericardial disease, history of ventricular tachycardia, symptomatic Congestive Heart Failure (CHF) New York Heart Association (NYHA) class III-IV, and severe uncontrolled arterial hypertension, according to the Investigator's opinion.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Relies on investigator opinion and multiple cardiovascular conditions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: QT interval corrected using Fridericia's formula (QTcF) >470 msec; personal or family history of prolonged QT syndrome or history of Torsades de pointes (TdP). History of risk factors for TdP
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: QTcF cutoff combined with personal and family histories that have no dedicated typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Treatment with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors within 1 week prior to the first dose of study drug or strong CYP3A4 inducers within 3 weeks prior to the first dose of study drug.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concomitant medication exclusion for CYP3A4 modulators.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Presence of known EGFR, KRAS, ALK, HER2, ROS1, BRAF and METex14 activating mutations.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: HER2 and METex14 do not have dedicated typed check kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Available RET-gene abnormalities determined on tissue biopsy or liquid biopsy. If deemed appropriate by the investigator, determination on a pleural cell block or cell pellet is also acceptable.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: RET gene abnormalities span fusions and other abnormalities, and there is no simple typed ret_status kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate hematopoietic, hepatic and renal function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Organ function is qualitative without specific lab cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable and/or non-measurable disease as determined by RECIST 1.1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: If patient has brain and/or leptomeningeal metastases, (s)he should be asymptomatic.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic CNS disease wording does not map to a clean typed brain_mets rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Cohort 1, 3: locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC patients naïve to RET selective inhibitors and no prior systemic anti-cancer treatment. Patients who have been treated with neo-adjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy may be included if it has been completed at least 6 months prior to the first dose of the study.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cohort-specific prior therapy requirements and stage descriptions are complex and differ by study part.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Cohort 2, 4: locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC patients with RET gene fusion and prior exposure to RET selective inhibitors.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cohort-specific prior exposure criteria cannot be expressed as a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease as determined by RECIST 1.1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: If patient has brain and/or leptomeningeal metastases,(s)he should have: asymptomatic untreated brain/leptomeningeal metastases off steroids and anticonvulsant for at least 7 days or asymptomatic brain metastases already treated with local therapy and be clinically stable on steroids and anticonvulsant for at least 7 days before study drug administration.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex brain metastases conditions involving treatment status, steroids, and duration are not captured by standard allowedBrainMets categories.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Locally advanced or metastatic: NSCLC patients with primary RET gene fusion and prior exposure to RET selective inhibitors; NSCLC patients with RET gene fusion and without prior exposure to RET selective inhibitors; patients with advanced solid tumors that harbour RET gene abnormalities (other than NSCLC patients with primary RET gene fusions) and has failed all the available therapeutic options
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Advanced or metastatic stage descriptions without numbered stages are kept as fuzzy.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance score of 0-2
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: ECOG max score varies across phases (0-1 for Phase 1, 0-2 for Phase 2), so a single typed check is not sufficient.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Investigational agents or anticancer therapy within 5 half-lives prior to the first dose of study drug
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window based on half-lives is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Major surgery (excluding placement of vascular access) within 4 weeks prior to the first dose of study drug or planned major surgery during the course of study treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Major surgery washout window is not a typed lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Whole Brain Radiotherapy within 14 days or other palliative radiotherapy within 7 days prior to the first dose of study drug, or persisting side effects of such therapy, in the opinion of the Investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Radiotherapy washout windows and investigator opinion on persisting side effects are fuzzy.

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex cardiovascular exclusions rely on investigator opinion and multiple combined conditions.

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concomitant medication restrictions are not a typed check.
